text:
In the Haber process, an equilibrium is established.
N2(g)  +  3H2(g)
2NH3(g)
The forward reaction is exothermic.
Which change to the reaction conditions will move the position of equilibrium to the left?
A
decreasing the pressure by 100atm
decreasing the temperature by 100°C
B
C
adding more nitrogen gas to the mixture
D
removing the iron catalyst

options.label: C
options.text: adding more nitrogen gas to the mixture

subject: Chemistry
